facts.fact: AdWave's agentic editing announcement post is dated December 18, 2025.
According to AdWave, its chat-based video editor has helped thousands of small business owners create and refine TV commercials without learning new software.
facts.quote: That approach has helped thousands of small business owners create and refine their TV commercials without learning any new software.

facts.fact: AdWave announced agentic editing, an AI that proactively guides users through the creative process, as the next evolution of its editor.
facts.quote: Today, we're announcing the next evolution: agentic editing.

facts.fact: AdWave's agentic editor gives users access to seven named tools: Text Editor, Color Change, Asset Position, Voice Change, Music Change, Scene Analyzer, and Style Transfer.
facts.quote: Behind the scenes, the AI now has access to specialized tools: Text Editor Tool, Color Change Tool, Asset Position Tool, Voice Change Tool, Music Change Tool, Scene Analyzer Tool, Style Transfer Tool

facts.fact: When a user asks broadly to update the look of an ad, AdWave's agentic editor offers interactive buttons for Scenes, Colors, Voice, Music, Fonts, Text, and Media.
facts.quote: Then it shows you interactive buttons: Scenes, Colors, Voice, Music, Fonts, Text, Media.

facts.fact: AdWave's agentic color editing lets users choose suggested palettes or enter an exact brand hex code.
facts.quote: Choose from suggested palettes or enter your exact brand hex code.

facts.fact: The vendor states that a color change that might have taken three back-and-forth messages in its earlier workflow now takes one tap with agentic editing.
facts.quote: A color change that might have taken three back-and-forth messages now takes one tap.

facts.fact: The vendor describes its agentic architecture as a nine-step pipeline that runs each time a user sends a message.
facts.quote: When you send a message, the AI:

facts.fact: The vendor says it wrote in May (year not stated) that it believes the future of software interaction is voice.
facts.quote: In May, we wrote about our belief that the future of software interaction is voice.

facts.fact: Adwave states that its TV advertising service starts at $30 a day for small businesses.
facts.quote: Adwave makes TV advertising accessible for small businesses, starting at just $30 a day.

facts.fact: Adwave states that its ads can reach customers on more than 100 premium streaming channels, including NBC, Hulu, and ESPN.
facts.quote: reach customers on 100+ premium streaming channels including NBC, Hulu, and ESPN.

facts.fact: Adwave says its agentic editing feature is rolling out to all Adwave users starting on the day the page was published.
facts.quote: Agentic editing is rolling out to all Adwave users starting today.
